calibration.note: Same seed and streams: ids, decks, sparks, skills, aptitudes, noise and the activation draws are identical; only blue activation gains (and so stats, rating, rank and fingerprint) differ. 70 §3 F12: calibration should suggest ×1.2–1.4.

deckModel.borrowed: 70% of decks have one borrowed slot (LB4, max level).
deckModel.level: owned cards are at the synthetic level cap for their LB (SSR 30/35/40/45/50 for LB0..4) with p .85, else 1–5 below; level has no planted effect (unverified caps).
deckModel.pool: the 12 planted + 12 zero-effect SSR cards (truth.trainingModel); 6 distinct cards per deck with distinct characters, never the veteran’s own character; each deck takes a uniform 2–5 planted cards (seeded order), then zero-effect cards; a card whose character is already used is skipped and the next card is taken (the other list fills any gap).

bestPair.why: best1: self 2★ blue speed, 2★ pink turf, 3★ white X; guest parent 1 with 2★ white X. best2: self 3★ blue stamina, 3★ pink medium; both guest parents 2★ blue stamina + 3★ pink medium. They are the two characters with the highest affinity2 with the trainee character. Only pairs containing best1 can hint X; only best2 brings 3★ medium pinks (every other medium pink is 1★).

golden.skillXWhy: skill:restraint (normal, gameId 202161) has exactly one spark (spark:restraint), is not in any card hint/event list, not innate or unique for any outfit, and not hinted by any race spark in rules.json. In the roster its only sources are the planted best parent 1 (self 3★) and that veteran’s guest parent 1 (2★).

trapPair.why: each trap veteran: self 3★ blue speed and both guest parents 3★ blue speed → 18 combined blue stars over the pair lineage, the unique maximum (every general veteran has ≤ 6: general blue sparks are never 3★; best1/best2 have 6/7). No source of skill X, no medium pink.

holdout.method: trainingEligibleIds sorted ascending, Fisher–Yates shuffle with mulberry32(seed) (engine src/rng.ts), first ceil(20%) = holdout; both lists stored sorted.

meta.notice: Synthetic dataset for engine tests (70 §2). Only master-data IDs are real; every planted value below is invented for testability and is not a game fact.

roster.capturedAt: dateAcquired + 0..20 days at 12:00Z (+37 s per index), all before meta.generatedAt
roster.hinted: per veteran: deck hint/event skills ∪ outfit innate skills ∪ latent[id].inheritanceHints (skills hinted by the sparks that activated in its sampled inheritance), minus the outfit unique skill
roster.ids: ULID: 48-bit time = capturedAt, 80 random bits from mulberry32(seedFromString(`20260929:vet:<index>`))
roster.minConfidence: general veterans: 8% are low-confidence (0.60–0.89), the rest 0.90–1.00; stats/skills/sparks of low-confidence rows are still the true generated values

modes.rule: exactly 60% independent / 40% manual over all 260 rows: the 4 planted veterans are manual, round(0.6 × 260) = 156 general veterans chosen by a Fisher–Yates permutation with mulberry32(seedFromString("20260929:modes")) are independent, the rest manual

parents.note: parent kinds for general veterans: matched roster veteran (p .55 when an earlier legal one exists), guest (isGuest, guestTrainer set), unmatched non-guest (outfit known, no matchedVeteranId). Matched parents are always earlier general veterans whose own record is complete (no unread parent sparks), so legacyFromVeteran(matched roster record) is exactly the lineage the generator used; the 4 planted veterans are never anyone’s parent.

roster.trainingEligibleRule: 50 §4: min_confidence ≥ 0.9 (every row has a scenario and both parents identified; unread parent sparks only occur on low-confidence rows)

skills.acquisition: Each hinted skill (except the outfit's unique skill) is acquired independently with probability rates[trainMode][skillId]. Nothing that was not hinted is ever acquired.
skills.hintedDefinition: hinted = deck cards' hintSkillIds ∪ eventSkillIds ∪ the outfit's innateSkillIds ∪ skills hinted by the sparks that actually activated in the veteran's own inheritance sample (green/white skill sparks and race sparks with hint skills).
skills.uniqueSkill: The outfit's uniqueSkillId is always acquired, with a synthetic level uniform in 1..6.

sparks.gradeRule: aptitudes = the outfit base + the sampled pink steps (engine sampleInheritance, capped at S).
sparks.guestSparks: synthetic guest/unmatched parents: 1 blue (1★/2★ p .55/.45), 1 pink (stars 1/2/3 p .5/.35/.15) (medium capped at 1★), their outfit's green with p .7, 0–3 random white skill sparks (never X), a race spark with p .3.
sparks.selfSparks: general veterans: 1 blue (uniform stat; stars 1/2 with p .55/.45, never 3★), 1 pink (an aptitude graded ≥ A if any, stars 1/2/3 p .5/.35/.15; medium capped at 1★), the outfit's own green spark with p .75, 1–4 white skill sparks from acquired skills (p .55/.35/.10), a race spark with p .35, its scenario's spark (1★) with p .10. Skill X never appears outside the planted best pair.

syntheticInheritance.guestsHaveNoLineage: Guest parents and unread/unmatched parents contribute their own recorded sparks only; synthetic guests have no parents of their own, so their grandparent slots are null (no sparks roll). Matched parents contribute their own sparks plus their recorded parents as grandparents.

syntheticInheritance.note: Inheritance is generated with T05 planInheritance/sampleInheritance on a context built by loadGoldenContext(master, truth, multiplier): rules.json values verbatim except the overrides below, plus a scenario plugin that returns the synthetic turns.

blueStatGain.source: SYNTHETIC (T08 golden dataset): rules.json blueStatGain is an UNKNOWN 0 placeholder (Q-3), which would make the ×1.3 calibration variant identical to the base. These per-activation gains are invented; see Q-120.

trainingModel.cardFeature: Per deck slot: perUnit[card] * (1 + lb/4), summed over the 6 slots (50 §4 'indicator × (1 + lb/4)'). Card level has no effect. Borrowed cards count like owned ones.
trainingModel.formula: stat_k = round(clip(baseline_k + modeIntercept[mode]_k + scenarioIntercept[scenario]_k + growthCoefficient_k * growth%_k(outfit, own stat k only) + Σ_deck perUnit[card]_k * (1 + lb/4) + noise_k + inheritanceSample_k, 1, statCap[scenario]))
trainingModel.growthNote: Each stat depends only on the outfit's growth % for that same stat (cross-stat growth coefficients are 0).

residualNoise.distribution: MVN(0, covariance), one independent draw per veteran

trainingModel.rounding: The sum is clipped to [1, statCap[scenarioId]] (master scenarios.json statCap) and rounded to the nearest integer (round-half-up on the clipped value).
trainingModel.timeTrend: None: no planted drift over dateAcquired (recency weights must not change the truth).
